name: Laris Geardawdle
summary: In Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, Laris Geardawdle welcomes travelers with samples of noxious slime. The gnome researcher gives his academic life to studying oozes across Azeroth and their strange nature and origins.

sections.title: Scholar of Slime
sections.body:
In the Hall of Explorers Library, Laris Geardawdle studies how oozes begin. His dwarven colleagues pore over Titan tablets and ancient stone carvings. Laris searches Azeroth's vile, gelatinous horrors for alchemical and biological secrets.

He asks roving explorers to gather caustic samples from remote corners of the world. With those samples, he tests his unusual ideas about how these mindless puddles of malice come to life.

faq.answer: Laris Geardawdle is a gnome researcher in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers Library. He studies oozes and slimes, and the strange way they come into being.

faq.q: Where can I find Laris Geardawdle?
faq.answer: You can find Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge's northern wing, inside the Hall of Explorers and its Library.

Laris Geardawdle studies oozes because his curious, eccentric mind has led him to form theories about how living slime begins. He believes caustic residue from different oozes can explain how these strange organisms form and replicate.

faq.q: What tasks does he offer adventurers?
aliases: a little slime goes a long way
faq.answer: Laris Geardawdle asks travelers to collect ooze samples in dangerous lands. In A Little Slime Goes a Long Way, he gives them empty ooze containers and sends them to Felwood to take samples from oozes they slay. Then he asks them to seek pure, uncorrupted samples.

angles.text: As a gnome, you share Laris Geardawdle's drive to seek knowledge in places everyone else overlooks. Sometimes that means reaching into foul swamp muck.
As an Alliance member, you can find Laris Geardawdle in the Hall of Explorers. His work brings eccentric natural science to the League's historical digging.
